reviews.title: Ehhhh
reviews.text: This app favors bad players because of the blocking system. If you’re good everyone will just block you so you won’t get a game. And the kicker with that is that the minimum withdrawal amount is $50. A side affect of having a weak blocking system, I know several players who’ve made double accounts on the app just to get games. I guess the developers don’t see it as a problem… on the flip side this app does have really good support that respond fast. But I would definitely recommend the other gaming apps that are similar but just overall better! Decent app.
